newsitem.title: USA: Tropical Storm Marco seen moving little in Carib.
newsitem.headline: Tropical Storm Marco seen moving little in Carib.

text.p: A tropical storm warning for Jamaica was replaced by a less-urgent tropical storm watch Thursday as Tropical Storm Marco drifted, moving little, in the Caribbean, National Hurricane Center said.
At 1000 EST/1500 GMT, Marco's center was near latitude 15.3 north and longitude 76.6 west, about 180 miles (295 km) south of Kingston, Jamaica.
"Marco has been meandering during the past few hours and little motion is expected today," the center said.

Maximum sustained winds were near 45 mph (75 kph) and little change in strength was likely during the next 24 hours, but forecasters said Marco still carried up to 15 inches (37.5 cm) of rain. Tropical storm force winds extended outward up to 80 miles (130 km) from Marco's center.

Forecasters also said that heavy rains not directly related to Marco were expected to continue over parts of Central America during the next day or two, which could result in flash floods and mud slides.
As of 1000 EST, a tropical storm watch for Cuba and Haiti was discontinued, National Hurricane Center added.
